svg.text: SCALE 1:25 · BOOKCASE · PANEL FOR PAINTING · WINDOW
COUNTER TOP LEVEL WITH THE WINDOW SILL
CUT AT 1200 · SCALE 1:25 · ROOM BELOW, WALL ABOVE
HARD INTO THE CORNER — NO RETURN ON THE RIGHT
Wall 14 ft 11 in, ceiling 9 ft 1 in (measured).
Centre panel set equal to the window bay so the two
pilasters frame a matched pair; the bookcase takes
the remainder as the anchor at the end of the wall.
Window measured: 4 ft wide, 5 ft 5 in tall, hard into
the right corner. Sill 2 ft 3 in (686) floor to the
Counter top is set to the sill at 686, so the two are
one surface; this datum runs on round to the right
Refs: 1 fluted pilasters + moulded panel; 2 block-and-
dentil cornice, no carving; 3 band panels over every
bay, twin sconces, pedestals forward, no arch.
Cupboards under all three bays. Gold on handles only.
8 — sill confirmed at 2 ft 3 in; datum fixed at 686
